mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, p.title, p.content, p.author_id, u.username AS author_name, p.is_public, p.view_count, p.is_pinned, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_likes WHERE post_id = p.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_comments WHERE post_id = p.id) AS comment_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM study_likes WHERE post_id = p.id AND user_id = #{currentUserId}) AS is_liked_by_me
false AS is_liked_by_me
FROM study_posts p INNER JOIN study_categories sc ON p.category_id = sc.id INNER JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_posts (category_id, title, content, author_id, is_public) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{isPublic})
mapper.update: UPDATE study_posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE study_posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE study_posts SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
